decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits very close to the firm's core organic dairy and cheese know-how, and its own page in 2019 suggests the firm learned from early results and integrated it into the assortment.
The spicy cheese extends established cheese-making knowledge and was promoted to its own page in 2019, but flavoured variants like Product B have been dropped before, which adds some risk.
